VALID_RETEST_ANCHORS.rule: an entry retest level must be one of: a 2-minute, 3-minute or 5-minute moving average; a VWAP level; or a volume-profile level.
VALID_RETEST_ANCHORS.not_valid: moving averages on any timeframe higher than 5 minutes (including the 15m and 60m MAs), Bollinger outer bands, and Fibonacci retracement levels. None of these may be used as retest_level.
VALID_RETEST_ANCHORS.scope: this constrains retest_level only. It says nothing about direction, conviction, targets, stop placement, or whether to take at all.
VALID_RETEST_ANCHORS.orchestrator_enforcement: the orchestrator validates retest_level against this rule before simulating a fill and rejects a take row that violates it.

CANCEL_IF_REACHES_RULE.rule: cancel_if_reaches is ALWAYS your first target. If price reaches TP1 before the limit fills, the move has gone without you and the order is cancelled.
CANCEL_IF_REACHES_RULE.consequence: your choice of TP1 therefore does two jobs: it sets the first target AND it sets the distance the order will tolerate before being abandoned.
CANCEL_IF_REACHES_RULE.orchestrator_enforcement: the orchestrator rejects a take row whose cancel_if_reaches price is not equal to targets[0].price.
